name: mosquitto
title: Mosquitto MQTT
description: Eclipse Mosquitto, the MQTT broker Home Assistant, Zigbee2MQTT, ESPHome, Frigate and most smart-home services talk to. Deploys with a working config (MQTT on 1883, WebSockets on 9001, anonymous clients allowed); to require logins, follow the comments in App-Data/Mosquitto/config/mosquitto.conf and restart.

variables.name: PORT_MQTT_WS
variables.label: WebSockets port
variables.description: Host port for MQTT over WebSockets (browser clients)

variables.name: MQTT_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS
variables.label: Allow anonymous clients
variables.description: true lets any client on your network connect without a login (fine on a LAN); false requires a password file, see the config comments
